page.overview:
Who is Black Nemesis?

The Black Nemesis was a male Human Black Sun pirate pilot who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, the Black Nemesis attacked freighters in the Tatoo system with his Rihkxyrk assault fighter. The pirate was eventually killed by pilots of the Mos Eisley Police.

The Black Nemesis appeared in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, The Black Nemesis was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack Jump to Lightspeed on October 27, 2004.
